items.html: *And all this matter you will understand in the Zohar, Parashat Beresheet, in what is said on the verse "And the Lord God built the rib" — that it is the matter of the sawing; and afterward "and He brought her to the man." From here we learn that Aba and Ima must bring the bride into the jurisdiction of the groom, as it is said, "I have given my daughter to this man." From here onward, her husband comes to her, for it is her house, as it is written, "and he came to her."
